tasks.short: Develop and maintain solar system diagrams

steps.what: Read current system architecture inputs and verify actual site changes
Develop the system architecture and resolve piping and instrumentation choices
Draw or revise piping, instrumentation and process flow diagrams
Check architecture diagrams against the actual equipment and interfaces
Save the working architecture diagrams in the existing drawing system

tasks.design: Configure reusable symbols and linked diagram views in the existing engineering drawing tool {OTHER}, using the actual specifications in {DOCS}. The manager chooses the architecture, draws the site-specific connections and checks every affected interface.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated symbols and diagram labels are redrawn when related views change.
tasks.enabler_now: Native symbol libraries and linked views can remove repeated drafting without making engineering decisions.
tasks.still_hard: A diagram must reflect real equipment, site constraints and the interaction of electrical and thermal components.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve engineering tradeoffs and detect when the drawing does not represent the installation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native drawing libraries can reuse symbols and linked views while architecture and interface checks remain engineering work.

assumptions: OTHER means the existing engineering drawing tool. Boundary is development and maintenance of working architecture diagrams, not issue for construction or an external engineering release.

Survey staff produce measured site inputs, equipment suppliers provide specifications and the manager verifies changes in s1. The manager creates the architecture in s2 and counts all site-specific drawing in s3.
s3 removes14 of35 units of repeated symbols and labels;21 remain for site-specific connections and revisions. Existing linked drawing functions already used produce no additional saving.
Ordinary author save is tiny and fully retained, with no invented approval. No layout or safety rule is treated as an engineering approval.
unknowns: Compatibility of existing layers and symbols
research_questions: Can a changed component update related views without altering site-specific connections?

already_counted.description: Verify inputs, decide architecture, finish drawings, check interfaces and save

incremental.description: Maintain symbols and repair incompatible drawing layers

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R86 gross14 less upkeep3 gives11. On an inherited thermal drawing with incompatible layers, drawing retains33 of35; input checking20, engineering35, review9 and save1 remain. Gross2 cannot cover upkeep3, so low0. This is a layer-compatibility case, not a percentage of the upper benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate subcontractor quality, cost and reliability

steps.what: Read the subcontractor scope and establish the actual evaluation criteria
Enter and verify subcontractor bid cost and scope fields
Calculate comparable subcontractor cost totals and flag missing scope fields
Evaluate subcontractor quality and reliability against scope and delivery evidence
Write the actual subcontractor evaluation with supporting reasons and limitations
Save the subcontractor evaluation in its existing file

tasks.design: Use a comparison workbook {SPREADSHEET} with fixed scope fields and transparent cost calculations, linked to the actual bid evidence in {DOCS}. The manager captures and verifies bid facts and makes the quality and reliability assessment; the workbook does not award a contract.
tasks.previous_blocker: Bid fields and arithmetic are repeatedly assembled while substantive reliability evidence varies.
tasks.enabler_now: A reusable comparison layout and deterministic totals separate clerical comparison from supplier judgement.
tasks.still_hard: A cheaper bid may omit work, and delivery evidence may be sparse or incomparable.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether the subcontractor can actually deliver the required work.

ambition.what: The manager retains subcontractor evaluation and any later award decision.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bid worksheets can calculate comparable totals from verified fields, but quality and reliability assessment requires project-specific evidence.

assumptions: Boundary is the existing written evaluation used in procurement, not a new report or an award, supplier message or contractual commitment.
Subcontractors supply bid documents. The manager captures quantities, units, rates, exclusions and scope references in s2; no structured supplier feed is presumed. s3 uses those verified fields only.

s2 removes five units of repeated headings and field layout, retaining20 for extraction and checking. s3 replaces actual manual arithmetic and fixed missing-field comparison; formula failures and incomparable units have funded manual repair.

The evaluation write exists as the decision basis, not an invented trailing record. Saving that author's file remains negligible, fully retained and ungated. If the current workbook already calculates totals, its runtime earns no new saving.
unknowns: Comparability of bid units and exclusions
How much manual arithmetic exists today
research_questions: Can two actual bids be compared without treating an exclusion as a zero price?

already_counted.description: Set criteria, capture bids, assess quality and reliability, write and save the real evaluation

incremental.description: Maintain comparison fields and repair formula, unit and scope mismatches

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gross20 less upkeep5 gives15. For bids with different units and many exclusions, extraction retains24 of25 and cost reconciliation retains9 of15; criteria10, judgement40, evaluation9 and save1 remain. R93 gross7 less upkeep5 gives2. No benefit is assigned to automatic awarding or ordinary saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The manager uses reusable drawing and bid-comparison structures while retaining engineering and supplier judgement.
reach: Maintain comparable engineering and procurement inputs
skills_to_grow: Manage drawing symbols and layer compatibility
Distinguish arithmetic checks from engineering decisions
role.ambitious_version: The manager spends more attention on actual interfaces and subcontractor delivery risks with less repeated drafting and comparison arithmetic.
